task: Generate one photorealistic still frame in the style of a casual vertical selfie video an original fictional man films of himself with his phone front camera, in his office, to talk to his audience. It will be used as the first frame of a talking-head video, so it should feel candid and authentic, like a frame from an everyday phone video.

output.look: raw, unedited iPhone front-camera video frame, not a professional photo

subject.identity: an original, non-famous Ecuadorian man (Latin American mestizo), 38 years old
subject.face: medium tan skin with natural texture (visible pores, slight unevenness, faint under-eye lines and light expression lines on the forehead), dark brown eyes, friendly and expressive features, slight natural facial asymmetry
subject.hair: short dark brown hair, slightly longer on top and combed back naturally, short on the sides, a few loose strands
subject.facial_hair: light, even stubble, about three days, natural edges
subject.accessories: thin black rectangular glasses with clear lenses, simple steel wristwatch on the left wrist, no other jewelry

wardrobe.top: navy blue button-up shirt in matte cotton, top button undone, sleeves buttoned at the wrists, natural fabric wrinkles
wardrobe.style: smart casual entrepreneur, polished but relaxed, nothing flashy, no visible logos

pose_and_expression.position: seated at his desk, upper body leaning very slightly toward the camera
pose_and_expression.gaze: looking directly into the lens, making eye contact with the viewer
pose_and_expression.expression: calm, confident and friendly, a subtle natural half-smile, as if about to start talking; mouth closed or barely parted, relaxed jaw
pose_and_expression.hands: both hands resting loosely on the desk in front of him in the lower part of the frame, fingers relaxed and slightly apart, all fingers anatomically correct and fully visible
pose_and_expression.posture: shoulders relaxed and square to the camera, natural and unposed

environment.location: his own modern, bright office in a business building, during the day
environment.background: a warm white wall, a light oak shelf behind him with a few plain closed binders without labels, a small ceramic pot with a green plant and a ceramic mug, a black ergonomic office chair, a glass partition far in the background showing a softly lit empty hallway; uncluttered; no window visible at his sides
environment.foreground: an open silver laptop at the bottom right edge of the frame, its screen facing him and not visible, slightly out of focus, on a light oak desk
environment.atmosphere: tidy, real, lived-in workspace, not a staged studio set

camera.device: iPhone front camera propped on the desk at chest-to-eye height, slightly below eye level
camera.lens: wide-angle selfie lens (about 24mm equivalent) with its natural mild perspective
camera.framing: medium close-up from the waist up, subject centered horizontally; his head sits in the upper-middle of the frame (eyes at about 38% of the frame height from the top), leaving clean empty wall above his head for on-screen graphics
camera.focus: face sharp, background softly in focus as a phone would render it (no artificial heavy bokeh)
camera.quality: 1080x1920 vertical video frame, slight phone sensor noise, mild compression, true-to-life colors

lighting.key: soft, diffused frontal daylight from a large window directly in front of him, behind the phone, lighting his whole face evenly from the front
lighting.fill: neutral white overhead office lights that brighten the room evenly
lighting.mood: bright, clean and realistic; both sides of the face equally lit with the same brightness and no side shadows, only very soft natural shading under the chin and nose; accurate skin tones, low contrast

realism_rules: must look like an ordinary person recorded on a phone, natural and authentic, not a stock photo
real skin texture, no smoothing, no beauty filter, no plastic or waxy skin
natural fabric folds and wrinkles on the shirt
correct human anatomy: two hands, five fingers each, natural proportions
realistic eyes behind the glasses with natural catchlights from the window in front of him, only faint natural reflections on the lenses
even, symmetrical illumination on the face, as when someone films himself facing a window
negative: text, captions, subtitles, logos, watermarks, UI elements, readable labels on the binders
side lighting, split lighting, one half of the face darker than the other, strong shadows on one side of the face, a window beside him lighting the face from the side
studio lighting, ring light reflections, cinematic color grading, heavy bokeh
strong glare on the glasses hiding the eyes
extra or deformed fingers, distorted hands, asymmetrical eyes, warped face
smooth or airbrushed skin, 3D render, cartoon, illustration, CGI look
suit and tie, formal wear, flashy clothes, visible brand logos
